usernames.title: Target Usernames
usernames.description: List of X/Twitter handles to check (e.g. ['elonmusk', 'apify']). Supports bulk edit (one handle per line).

delayBetweenRequests.title: Delay Between Requests (ms)
delayBetweenRequests.description: Pause between each profile visit in milliseconds to reclaim memory and throttle requests.

batchSize.title: Batch Size
batchSize.description: Number of profiles processed before flushing to database.

supabaseUrl.title: Supabase Project URL
supabaseUrl.description: Optional Supabase Project URL for direct cloud streaming persistence.

supabaseAnonKey.title: Supabase Anon/Public Key
supabaseAnonKey.description: Optional Supabase Anonymous API Key for direct cloud streaming persistence.
